bio.text: Justin Filip is a candidate for Oregon's 4th Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 general election, listed with the Progressive Party and the Pacific Green Party of Oregon.
Ballotpedia reports he was born in Michigan, moved to Oregon in 1995, and earned a bachelor's degree in psychology from the University of Oregon.
It lists his party and community roles as secretary of the Pacific Green Party, co-chair of its Eugene chapter, and cultural development chair of the Buena Vista Parent Organization.
